/.title: Bamboo Shop in Shidlaghatta, Karnataka | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/.description: Explore bamboo baskets, Mara trays, hand fans, poles and ladders at Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Garden Road, Shidlaghatta. English and Kannada product names.

/shop.title: Bamboo Baskets, Trays, Fans & Poles | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/shop.description: Browse our bamboo product catalogue with owner-supplied INR prices, English and Kannada names, photographs and specifications. Confirm availability before payment.

/collections.title: Nine Bamboo Collections in English & Kannada | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections.description: Explore Butti baskets, Koolu materials, Kuduru, Makkari, Mara trays, Panjara, Shibbilu, Thottilu and Bechanage. Compare uses and ask the Shidlaghatta workshop.

/story.title: Our Bamboo Workshop in Shidlaghatta | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/story.description: Meet Sri Balaji Bamboo Works on Garden Road in Shidlaghatta, Chikkaballapur. Discover traditional woven forms and bamboo products for everyday use.

/bulk.title: Bulk Bamboo Baskets, Poles & Materials | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/bulk.description: Ask Sri Balaji Bamboo Works about bulk quantities, sizes, materials and delivery. Send your requirements to our Shidlaghatta workshop for a confirmed quotation.

/contact.title: Contact Our Bamboo Shop in Shidlaghatta | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/contact.description: Visit 5, Garden Road, Shidlaghatta, Chikkaballapur, Karnataka 562105. Call +91 9591457484 or email balajibambooworks@gmail.com for bamboo product enquiries.

/care.title: Bamboo Product Care & Ordering Guide | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/care.description: Learn how to keep woven bamboo clean and dry, choose a product, confirm measurements and request an order. Pay by UPI only after the workshop approves your total.

/collections/butti.title: Butti Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/butti.description: Butti (ಬುಟ್ಟಿಗಳು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. Rounded baskets for household and occasion requirements. Compare Biryani, Dyaawara, Marriage and Small Butti by form, weave and the dimensions you need.

/collections/koolu.title: Koolu Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/koolu.description: Koolu (ಕೋಲು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿದಿರು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. From long Galuvu and paired poles to handle sticks, Jatree Dabbe strips and ladders. Choose the material form and specify the length, width or diameter for your project.

/collections/kuduru.title: Kuduru Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/kuduru.description: Kuduru (ಹೆಣೆದ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ವಸ್ತು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. A distinctive woven form with a narrow centre and flared openings. Explore the workshop photograph, then discuss the dimensions and intended use you need.

/collections/makkari.title: Makkari Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/makkari.description: Makkari (ಮಕ್ಕರಿ) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. Larger basket forms with individual character. Compare Butta, Kasa and Shett Makkari through their rounded profiles, broad structural strips and woven bases.

/collections/mara.title: Mara Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/mara.description: Mara (ಮರ / ಮೊರ) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. A familiar winnowing form with a herringbone surface and curved rim. Choose home-use, large, medium or small, then confirm the actual measurements and available finish.

/collections/panjara.title: Panjara Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/panjara.description: Panjara (ಪಂಜರಗಳು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. Bamboo and Echalu hen-basket types with open weaves and rounded profiles. Compare both forms and confirm the opening, height and construction for your requirement.

/collections/shibbilu.title: Shibbilu Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/shibbilu.description: Shibbilu (ಹೂವು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂಜೆಯ ಬುಟ್ಟಿಗಳು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. Shallow woven forms for flowers, pooja and occasion requirements. Choose a Shibbilu pair, a large single basket or the separate Coconut Thatte.

/collections/thottilu.title: Thottilu Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/thottilu.description: Thottilu (ತೊಟ್ಟಿಲು) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. A traditional elongated woven cradle body, shown as stored in the workshop. Discuss the exact dimensions, supplied components and fittings before ordering.

/collections/bechanage.title: Bechanage Bamboo Collection | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works
/collections/bechanage.description: Bechanage (ಬೀಸಣಿಗೆ) at our Shidlaghatta bamboo shop. A familiar handheld fan with green-and-magenta woven accents. A small splash of colour, a long handle and the character of a natural weave.

/product/biryani-basket.title: Biryani Basket | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/biryani-basket.description: Biryani Basket (ಬಿರಿಯಾನಿ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ): ₹420. An open, rounded basket from the Biryani Basket collection. Its broad base strips, flared rim and natural weave are visible in the product photo. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/dyaawara-basket.title: Dyaawara Basket | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/dyaawara-basket.description: Dyaawara Basket (ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ): ₹650. Broad structural strips frame a rounded woven body. Explore the Dyaawara basket from the inside, base and side to see its form and natural finish. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/marriage-basket.title: Marriage Basket | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/marriage-basket.description: Marriage Basket (ಮದುವೆ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ): ₹400. A rounded, deeper basket for marriage and occasion requirements. Compare the body and base views, then tell us the size, finish and number of baskets you need. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/small-basket.title: Small Basket | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/small-basket.description: Small Basket (ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ): ₹150–₹200. The owner’s small Butti option, quoted at ₹150–₹200. The photograph is a representative small basket from the collection; confirm the exact design and measurements for your order. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/bamboo-galuvu.title: Bamboo Galuvu | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/bamboo-galuvu.description: Bamboo Galuvu (ಉದ್ದ ಬಿದಿರು): ₹350 / piece. Long bamboo lengths with visible natural nodes and varied diameters. Specify the length and thickness you need; Galuvu is priced individually. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/bamboo-poles.title: Bamboo Poles | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/bamboo-poles.description: Bamboo Poles (ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಕೋಲುಗಳು): ₹800 / pair. Natural bamboo poles supplied by the pair. The stock photograph shows their varied thicknesses and nodes. Confirm the length and diameter of the pair for your requirement. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/hammer-sticks.title: Hammer Sticks | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/hammer-sticks.description: Hammer Sticks (ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಹಿಡಿಗಳು): ₹150. Handle sticks or blanks from the Hammer Sticks section. Different lengths and thicknesses are visible; confirm the required handle dimensions and material for your purpose. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/jatree-dabbe.title: Jatree Dabbe | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/jatree-dabbe.description: Jatree Dabbe (ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು): ₹10–₹15 / piece. Straight, flat split strips with a natural finish. Specify the required length, width and thickness; the price for each strip is confirmed within the listed range. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/bamboo-ladder.title: Bamboo Ladder | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/bamboo-ladder.description: Bamboo Ladder (ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಏಣಿ): ₹85–₹90 / foot. A bamboo ladder with natural rails and transverse rungs. Enter the length of each ladder in feet and the number of ladders to estimate your selection. Confirm the exact construction and dimensions with the workshop. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/kuduru.title: Kuduru | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/kuduru.description: Kuduru (ಹೆಣೆದ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ವಸ್ತು): ₹600. The workshop’s Kuduru, shown with a narrow central section and flared woven ends. Its local product name is retained; tell us the purpose and dimensions you need so the exact form can be confirmed. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/butta-makkari.title: Butta Makkari | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/butta-makkari.description: Butta Makkari (ದುಂಡು ಮಕ್ಕರಿ): ₹150. An open, rounded large basket with broad framework strips and a woven base. The interior, base and side views help you compare the Butta form before choosing your dimensions. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/kasa-makkari.title: Kasa Makkari | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/kasa-makkari.description: Kasa Makkari (ಅಗಲ ಬಾಯಿಯ ಮಕ್ಕರಿ): ₹300. A rounded basket with a wide opening and visible structural strips. Explore the interior and base views, then specify the diameter and depth that suit your requirement. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/shett-makkari.title: Shett Makkari | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/shett-makkari.description: Shett Makkari (ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹೆಣೆದ ಮಕ್ಕರಿ): ₹300–₹350. A rounded Makkari with visible structural bands and a distinctive woven body. Compare the interior, base and side views and confirm the size and weave for your quotation. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/mara-home.title: Home-use Mara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/mara-home.description: Home-use Mara (ಮನೆ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಮರ / ಮೊರ): ₹250. A home-use winnowing tray with a herringbone surface and a curved top rim. The photograph shows nested stock with the natural variations of the woven material. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/mara-large.title: Large Mara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/mara-large.description: Large Mara (ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮರ / ಮೊರ): ₹300. The larger Mara selection, with a woven herringbone surface and raised curved edges. Confirm the actual width, length and available finish before ordering. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/mara-medium.title: Medium Mara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/mara-medium.description: Medium Mara (ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಮರ / ಮೊರ): ₹200. A medium Mara with a close herringbone weave, a plain natural finish and a curved rim. A familiar traditional form; confirm the measurements that suit your household. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/mara-small.title: Small Mara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/mara-small.description: Small Mara (ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮರ / ಮೊರ): ₹150. A small Mara with green-and-magenta accents woven through its natural surface. Confirm the available pattern and measurements when choosing your tray. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/bamboo-panjara.title: Bamboo Panjara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/bamboo-panjara.description: Bamboo Panjara (ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಪಂಜರ): ₹400–₹450. An open-weave bamboo hen basket with a dome-like body and a broad circular opening. Specify the diameter, height and construction required for your purpose. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/echalu-panjara.title: Echalu Panjara | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/echalu-panjara.description: Echalu Panjara (ಈಚಲು ಪಂಜರ): ₹400. The Echalu hen-basket type, with a broader natural weave and a rounded body. Compare its visible construction with Bamboo Panjara and confirm the material and dimensions. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/shibbilu-pair.title: Shibbilu Basket Pair | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/shibbilu-pair.description: Shibbilu Basket Pair (ಪೂಜೆಯ ಬುಟ್ಟಿಗಳ ಜೋಡಿ): ₹400 / pair. A pair of Shibbilu flower or pooja baskets at ₹400 for the pair. The photo shows the basket form; quantity in the bag counts pairs, so one pair represents two baskets. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/shibbilu-large.title: Large Shibbilu Basket | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/shibbilu-large.description: Large Shibbilu Basket (ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪೂಜೆಯ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ): ₹250 / piece. A large single Shibbilu with a broad round form and visible radial base strips. Choose the dimensions and weave you need for your flower, pooja or occasion requirement. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/coconut-thatte.title: Coconut Thatte | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/coconut-thatte.description: Coconut Thatte (ತೆಂಗಿನಕಾಯಿ ತಟ್ಟೆ): ₹500. A shallow round Coconut Thatte, also called a coconut plate, with a visible woven surface and radial base pattern. Confirm the diameter and finish for your requirement. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/thottilu.title: Thottilu · Woven Cradle | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/thottilu.description: Thottilu · Woven Cradle (ಬಿದಿರಿನ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಲು): ₹800. An elongated woven cradle body, shown hanging vertically as stored in the workshop. Confirm dimensions, supplied components, fittings and intended use directly with the business. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.

/product/bechanage.title: Bechanage · Hand Fan | Sri Balaji Bamboo Works, Shidlaghatta
/product/bechanage.description: Bechanage · Hand Fan (ಬೀಸಣಿಗೆ): ₹50 / piece. A rectangular woven hand fan with a long handle and green-and-magenta accents. The natural strips form a lively geometric pattern; confirm the available colours and design. Confirm measurements, availability and delivery with our Shidlaghatta workshop.
